plugins.description: A self-evolving knowledge system for AI-paired builders, on Karpathy's LLM-Wiki principle. CORE: self-closing wiki loop (ingest → cross-link → filed-query → compounding) plus auto-dreaming (frozen pages resurface on relevance). Phase 1 (current): AI-paired engineering — compile project business semantics for agent preflight. Phase 2 (designed): team spec authoring + dispute resolution. Phase 3+: open. Builders inherit a kata, adapt it, transcend the form. 13 skills, multi-machine git sync, multi-CLI session ingest (v1.11 in flight).
